name: Aegiochusmon: Dark
look: Aegiochusmon gone dark: black fur, black wings, red eyes and a red-bladed scythe
entry: Aegiochusmon fallen to darkness: black-winged and red-eyed, it reaps its foes with a storm-forged scythe and feeds on their fear.
how: Wild: rare in hills, plains, spooky biomes and forests.
